measurements.limitation: Measured as apparent T4 diffusion in water through filter paper; not a Petra agarose-dish coefficient.
Measured in a 0.5% agarose gel membrane without embedded host cells.
Measured with dead E. coli K-12 embedded in 0.5% agarose; adsorption contributes to the lower apparent diffusion coefficient and this is not a living-host transport constant.

petraCalibration.limitation: Transferred from a two-chamber agarose-gel-membrane measurement to Petra's 2-D extracellular transport baseline. It is valid only for the explicitly selected 0.5% host-free agarose calibration context; host-bearing regions, other agarose concentrations, liquid media, and other matrices are out of domain until separately calibrated.

freePhageLoss.limitation: No compatible general environmental T4 free-phage loss constant is bound for this Petra matrix. Nabergoj's zero-loss model term is not promoted to a measured spatial decay constant.
